consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at the Fox Theater on May 18, 1977, highlighting the exceptional quality of the 'Eyes of the World' and 'Stella Blue' as standout moments. Many reviewers note the band's tightness and chemistry, with several considering this show among the best of the era.
